grounded_facts: Finn and Rey retrieve and put on gas masks in preparation for a trap.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn and Rey grab the gas masks and put them on before climbing into the grating area.

grounded_facts: Han Solo and Chewbacca return and board the Millennium Falcon to reclaim it.
memories.memory_text: I returned with Chewbacca and boarded the Millennium Falcon, ready for a fight to reclaim my ship.

grounded_facts: Han Solo and Chewbacca return to the Millennium Falcon and board it cautiously.
memories.memory_text: I boarded the Falcon with Chewie, weapons ready, moving cautiously and silently with hand signals.

grounded_facts: Finn and Rey hide under the grating with BB-8 to avoid detection.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Finn and Rey hiding under the grating with BB-8, and when I pulled the cover off, they raised their hands, scared of me.

grounded_facts: Han demands to know where the other crew members are and who the pilot is.
memories.memory_text: I demanded to know where the others were and who the pilot was when we found the intruders.

grounded_facts: Rey reveals she is the pilot of the Millennium Falcon.
memories.memory_text: I saw and heard Rey say she was the pilot of the Falcon when I asked who was flying it.

grounded_facts: Finn refers to Chewbacca as 'that thing', showing disrespect.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn refer to Chewie as 'that thing,' which immediately set me on edge.

grounded_facts: Han comments to Chewie that they should have double-checked the Western Reaches.
memories.memory_text: I told Chewie we should've double-checked the Western Reaches.

grounded_facts: Han Solo reclaims ownership of the Millennium Falcon after learning its history.
memories.memory_text: I learned from Rey that the Falcon was stolen from Ducain, who stole it from me, so I reclaimed it and told her that I just stole it back for good.

grounded_facts: Rey recognizes Han Solo and expresses awe at being on the Millennium Falcon.
memories.memory_text: I walked onto the Falcon and took it in—this ship is mine again. I could feel Rey's awe when she recognized me, asking if I was really Han Solo and if this was the Millennium Falcon.

grounded_facts: Finn and Rey debate whether Han Solo is a Rebellion General or a smuggler.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn and Rey debating who I really am—Finn thought I was a Rebellion General, and Rey corrected him, saying I'm the smuggler, while Finn kept pressing, wondering if I was a war hero.

grounded_facts: Han finds a compressor improperly placed on the ignition line, which annoys him.
memories.memory_text: I was feeling good for a moment, but then I saw it — someone had put a compressor on the ignition line, and that annoyed me. I said out loud, 'Hey! Some moof-milker put a compressor on the ignition line!'

grounded_facts: Han orders Chewie to put Rey and Finn in a pod and drop them on the nearest inhabited planet, showing his initial refusal to help them.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Chewie to put Rey and Finn in a pod and drop them on the nearest inhabited planet because I wasn't buying their story.

grounded_facts: Rey urgently asks Han to help them deliver the droid to the Resistance base.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Rey that they needed my help to deliver the droid to the Resistance base.

grounded_facts: Finn discloses that BB-8 possesses a map leading to Luke Skywalker, which directly impacts Han's emotional state and attention.
memories.memory_text: I was told that BB-8 has a map leading to Luke Skywalker, which caught my attention right away.

grounded_facts: Finn attempts to establish credibility and urgency by reminding Han of his past as a Rebellion fighter and his personal connection to Luke Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I remember Finn telling me that I fought with the Rebellion and knew Luke, trying to make me see how serious this was.

grounded_facts: A loud metallic sound suggests a Rathtar has escaped, prompting Han and others to leave the lounge area immediately.
memories.memory_text: I heard a loud metallic sound that made me realize a Rathtar had escaped, so I knew we had to get out of the lounge area right away.

grounded_facts: The mention of Luke Skywalker deeply affects Han, causing him to stop and acknowledge his personal connection to Luke.
memories.memory_text: I knew Luke. When Finn mentioned him, I had to stop and acknowledge that connection—I couldn't just brush it off.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter between Han Solo and the newcomers (Rey, Finn, BB-8) in the lounge area of the Millennium Falcon, where urgent requests and past connections are revealed.
memories.memory_text: I remember the tense moment in the Falcon's lounge when Rey and Finn showed up with BB-8, and everything felt urgent and off.

grounded_facts: Finn asks Han whether they are transporting Rathtars, seeking clarification about potential dangers.
memories.memory_text: Finn asked me if I was hauling Rathtars on this freighter, clearly worried about what kind of danger we might be in.

grounded_facts: Han confirms that he is transporting Rathtars, dangerous creatures, which introduces immediate danger and explains his urgency.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to Finn that I'm hauling Rathtars, knowing full well how dangerous they are and why we need to move fast.

grounded_facts: Han discovers via surveillance that the Guavian Death Gang's transport ship is landing on the freighter, indicating they have been tracked and are now under threat.
memories.memory_text: I saw on the control panel that a transport ship was landing on the freighter, and it scared me — we were being watched.

grounded_facts: Han identifies the incoming ship as belonging to the Guavian Death Gang, declaring that they have been tracked.
memories.memory_text: I recognized the ship as belonging to the Guavian Death Gang and told the others they must've tracked us from Nantoon.

grounded_facts: Han instructs Rey, Finn, and BB-8 to go below deck and remain hidden until further notice, asserting control over their movements and BB-8's custody.
Han issues a direct order for the group to stay below deck and not attempt to take the Falcon, establishing leadership and control.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey, Finn, and BB-8 to get below deck and stay hidden until I say otherwise, and I made it clear they’re not to even think about taking the Falcon while I handle things.

grounded_facts: Han retains custody of BB-8, denying Rey immediate access, with a promise to return the droid after resolving the gang situation.
In response to Rey's inquiry, Han states BB-8 will stay with him until the gang is dealt with, creating a conditional separation.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey that BB-8 stays with me until I deal with the gang, and only then can she have him back.

grounded_facts: A Rathtar's grotesque tongue slams into a container window, revealing the creature's proximity and danger, shocking Finn and confirming Han's warning.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A Rathtar's grotesque tongue slams into a container window, revealing the creature's proximity and danger, shocking Finn and confirming Han's warning.

grounded_facts: After the Rathtar's tongue smashes the window, Han confirms its identity, validating Finn's fear and the immediate danger.
memories.memory_text: I remember that After the Rathtar's tongue smashes the window, Han confirms its identity, validating Finn's fear and the immediate danger.

grounded_facts: The Guavian Death Gang arrives on the cargo ship via a portal, positioning themselves at one end of the corridor and confronting Han Solo and his group.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Guavian Death Gang come through a portal and line up at the end of the corridor, facing me and my group.

grounded_facts: Han responds to Bala-Tik's threat with a friendly smile and an innocent question, attempting to downplay the tension.
memories.memory_text: I smiled at Bala-Tik and asked, 'What's the problem?' to keep things light when his gang showed up, even though I knew they were after me for the debt.

grounded_facts: Bala-Tik directly challenges Han Solo, declaring him a dead man and accusing him of defaulting on a large debt.
memories.memory_text: Bala-Tik called me a dead man and told me I defaulted on a fifty thousand credit debt they claimed I owed.

grounded_facts: Bala-Tik accuses Han Solo of failing to repay a fifty-thousand-credit debt for a job, establishing the conflict motive.
memories.memory_text: I remember Bala-Tik confronting me, saying they loaned me fifty thousand credits for a job and now I owe them.

grounded_facts: Han attempts to downplay his debt by questioning the cost of Rathtar hunting and claiming he spent the money.
memories.memory_text: I told Tasu Leech that hunting Rathtars isn't cheap and that I already spent the money he's after.

grounded_facts: Tasu Leech declares that Han's time is up, signaling imminent violence.
memories.memory_text: Tasu Leech told me it was over for me, and I knew things were about to get ugly.

grounded_facts: Bala-Tik reveals that the First Order is searching for BB-8 and two fugitives.
memories.memory_text: Bala-Tik told me the First Order is looking for BB-8 and two fugitives.

grounded_facts: Rey and Finn exchange a fearful look upon learning the First Order is after them.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Rey and Finn suddenly freeze and exchange a fearful look when they heard the First Order was after them, and I realized they were in real trouble.

grounded_facts: Razoo Qin-Fee orders a Kanjiklubber to search the freighter for the fugitives.
memories.memory_text: I saw Razoo Qin-Fee order a Kanjiklubber to search the freighter for the fugitives.

grounded_facts: The gangs decide to kill Han's group and seize BB-8 upon learning of the First Order bounty.
memories.memory_text: I heard Bala-Tik shout to kill us and take BB-8 after learning about the First Order's bounty, so I knew the gangs were no longer just after the debt.

grounded_facts: Han is confronted by two criminal gangs—Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub—over unpaid debts.
memories.memory_text: I was confronted by the Guavian Death Gang and Kanjiklub over unpaid debts, and I tried to reason with them, but they weren't having it — then that Rathtar showed up and everything went sideways.

grounded_facts: Han incapacitates a Kanjiklub gang member with a single punch and throws him to the Rathtar.
memories.memory_text: I punched a Kanjiklub gang member hard enough to take him down and threw him toward the Rathtar to clear our escape path.

grounded_facts: Han instructs Chewie to provide covering fire while he moves to open the hatch.
memories.memory_text: I told Chewie to cover me while I moved to open the hatch.

grounded_facts: An active confrontation between Han, Chewie, BB-8 and gang members at the far end of the corridor, involving cover-taking and exchanged fire.
memories.memory_text: I remember taking cover with Chewie and BB-8 while blaster fire echoed down the corridor from the gang members at the far end.

grounded_facts: Chewie is hit in the shoulder by enemy blaster fire and collapses with a loud groan.
memories.memory_text: I saw Chewie get hit in the shoulder by enemy fire and he went down with a loud groan.

grounded_facts: Han reacts to Chewie being hit by calling out to him and asking if he is okay.
memories.memory_text: I called out to Chewie right after he was hit, asking if he was okay.

grounded_facts: Han successfully operates the controls to open the hatch, revealing the Falcon in the distance.
memories.memory_text: I operated the controls and got the hatch open, seeing the Falcon in the distance just before Chewie was hit.

grounded_facts: After Chewie is wounded, Han grabs Chewie's bowcaster and uses it to fire at the door controls.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Chewie's bowcaster and fired it at the door controls to keep us moving.

grounded_facts: Han helps a visibly injured Chewbacca up the ramp of the Falcon amid urgent circumstances.
memories.memory_text: I helped my wounded partner Chewbacca up the ramp as we boarded the Falcon.

grounded_facts: Han directly orders Rey to close the Falcon's door as they board.
Han instructs Rey to close the door of the Millennium Falcon as they board under urgency.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey to close the door behind us as we were boarding the Falcon.

grounded_facts: Han instructs Finn to take care of the wounded Chewbacca.
Han tells Finn to take responsibility for the wounded Chewbacca during boarding.
memories.memory_text: I told Finn to take care of Chewie while we were getting onboard.

grounded_facts: A group urgently boards the Millennium Falcon in a cargo ship hangar while under pressure, tending to a wounded member.
memories.memory_text: I saw us rushing to board the Falcon in the hangar, with Chewie hurt and everyone under pressure.

grounded_facts: Rey moves to Chewbacca's seat and begins operating controls, asserting her role in the ship's operation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey move past me and take position at Chewie's station, starting to work the controls.

grounded_facts: Han asks Rey where she is going as she moves past him.
memories.memory_text: I asked Rey where she was going as she moved past me.

grounded_facts: Rey states that the fuel pump installed by Unkar Plutt must be primed for the ship to function.
Rey informs Han about the need to prime the fuel pump to enable departure.
memories.memory_text: Rey told me that the fuel pump installed by Unkar Plutt had to be primed, or we weren't going anywhere.

grounded_facts: Han verbally expresses dislike for Unkar Plutt, indicating past negative association.
memories.memory_text: I hate that guy, Unkar Plutt — just hearing his name brings back bad memories.

grounded_facts: Rey implies she should serve as co-pilot during the upcoming flight.
Rey suggests that Han could use her as a co-pilot.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey say I could use a co-pilot, implying she should take that role on the flight, but I know Chewbacca already has that job.

grounded_facts: Han decides to initiate lightspeed escape from inside the hangar, a risky maneuver he avoids questioning until after execution.
memories.memory_text: I decided to jump to lightspeed from inside the hangar, and I told Rey to watch the thrust as we prepared to blast out.

grounded_facts: Rey reacts with shock to Han's plan to jump to lightspeed from inside the hangar, questioning its feasibility.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey react with shock when I announced the lightspeed jump, and she asked me if it was even possible from inside the hangar.

grounded_facts: A Rathtar jumps onto the windshield of the Millennium Falcon, chewing at the glass, causing immediate danger and panic.
memories.memory_text: I saw a Rathtar leap onto the windshield and start chewing through the glass, which made me realize we had no time to waste.

grounded_facts: Han directs Rey to angle the shields during the escape, showing reliance on her assistance in crisis.
memories.memory_text: I called out to Rey to angle the shields during the escape, counting on her to handle it while I focused on the jump.

grounded_facts: The Millennium Falcon successfully activates its hyperdrive, escaping the attackers.
memories.memory_text: I hit the switch again after she showed me, and I saw the hyperdrive fire up, pulling us into lightspeed just as the attackers were blown back.

grounded_facts: Rey confidently identifies and fixes the hyperdrive compressor issue, overriding Han's failed attempt.
memories.memory_text: I was trying to get the hyperdrive working, but Rey reached over and hit the compressor switch like it was nothing, and she was right.

grounded_facts: Bala-Tik informs the First Order that Han Solo has the droid they are seeking and that it is aboard the Millennium Falcon.
memories.memory_text: I heard Bala-Tik report to the First Order that I have the droid they're after and that it's aboard the Millennium Falcon.

grounded_facts: Han identifies a coolant leak in the Millennium Falcon, indicating a critical system failure.
memories.memory_text: I saw the coolant was leaking and realized we had a serious problem aboard the Falcon.

grounded_facts: A high-pressure situation aboard the Millennium Falcon involving system failures and crew responding under chaos.
memories.memory_text: I remember the chaos on the Falcon when systems started failing and Rey and I had to act fast.

grounded_facts: Rey proposes and Han begins transferring auxiliary power to the secondary tank to address system issues.
Rey suggests a technical solution which Han accepts and acts upon.
memories.memory_text: Rey suggested transferring auxiliary power to the secondary tank, and I immediately started doing it.

grounded_facts: Han issues a direct threat toward an unspecified opponent in response to Chewie being hurt.
memories.memory_text: I threatened the one who hurt Chewie — they're going to deal with me now.

grounded_facts: Rey bypasses the compressor, stopping the alarms in the Falcon cockpit and stabilizing the hyperdrive system.
memories.memory_text: I was at the controls when the alarms suddenly stopped, and Rey told me she had bypassed the compressor to stabilize the hyperdrive.

grounded_facts: Han expresses quiet appreciation for Rey's successful repair of the hyperdrive through a laugh and look.
memories.memory_text: I gave Rey a look and let out a quiet laugh to show I appreciated her fixing the hyperdrive just in time.

grounded_facts: Han tells BB-8 to move out of the way as he exits the cockpit.
memories.memory_text: I told BB-8 to move out of the way as I was leaving the cockpit.

grounded_facts: Han tells Chewie not to speak, assuring him he did well and should rest.
memories.memory_text: I told Chewie not to speak, assuring him he did great and just needed to rest.

grounded_facts: Han expresses gratitude to Finn for his actions, marking a moment of recognition and acceptance.
memories.memory_text: I thanked Finn and told him he did a good job, recognizing what he'd done for us.

grounded_facts: Rey downplays her significance by identifying herself as just a scavenger.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey say she was just a scavenger, trying to downplay who she was, but I wasn't so sure about that.

grounded_facts: Han gives Finn a skeptical look and asks about their fugitive status.
memories.memory_text: I gave Finn a skeptical look and asked, 'So, fugitives, huh?' to figure out what they were mixed up in.

grounded_facts: BB-8 displays a holographic map of the galaxy, revealing a partial map related to Luke Skywalker's location.
memories.memory_text: I saw BB-8 project a holographic map of the galaxy, revealing a partial map that might lead to Luke Skywalker's location.

grounded_facts: Han asks BB-8 to show what data it has, prompting the map projection.
memories.memory_text: I told BB-8 to show me what it had, so it projected a holographic map that filled the room with stars and planets.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the Falcon's lounge where BB-8 reveals a holographic map leading to Luke Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Falcon's lounge when BB-8 projected a holographic map showing stars and planets, and I moved through the image, thinking about what it meant.

grounded_facts: Han shares his belief in the Force and Jedi, marking a shift from skepticism to affirmation.
memories.memory_text: I admitted to myself and the others that I once doubted the Force and the Jedi, but now I know it's all real.

grounded_facts: Han commits to assisting Rey and Finn by taking them to an old friend who can help deliver BB-8.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey and Finn they've got my help—I'm taking them to see an old friend who can get BB-8 where he needs to go. This is our stop.

grounded_facts: Rey is deeply moved upon seeing a vast green landscape, expressing awe and emotion, indicating a significant sensory and emotional experience new to her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey looking out the windshield, almost in tears, and heard her say, 'I didn't know there was this much green in the whole galaxy,' clearly moved by the sight.

grounded_facts: Han notices Rey's emotional state and is personally affected by her vulnerability, marking a moment of empathetic connection.
memories.memory_text: I noticed how vulnerable Rey looked when she saw the green landscape, and it really touched me—something about her reaction got to me in a way I didn't expect.

grounded_facts: Finn tells Han that he holds a significant position in the Resistance, which makes him a target and raises concerns about security aboard the ship.
memories.memory_text: Finn told me he's a big deal in the Resistance, which makes him a target, and he asked if there were any First Order sympathizers aboard.

grounded_facts: Finn initially calls Han 'Solo' and then corrects himself, showing uncertainty in their relationship dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Finn first called me 'Solo' and then corrected himself to 'Han'—he seemed unsure how to talk to me, like he didn't know where we stood.

grounded_facts: Han dismisses Finn's concerns about enemies by telling him that 'women always figure out the truth,' implying Finn's personal issues are more pressing than external threats.
memories.memory_text: I told Finn he had a bigger problem than spies—women always figure out the truth—so he should worry less about conspirators and more about what really matters.

grounded_facts: Han hands a blaster to Finn during a conversation in the lounge area of the Millennium Falcon, signaling preparation for potential conflict.
memories.memory_text: I handed Finn a blaster during our talk in the lounge area of the Millennium Falcon, letting him know he should be ready in case things got rough.

grounded_facts: Han gives Rey a blaster pistol, indicating concern for her safety and signaling trust.
memories.memory_text: I gave Rey my blaster because I knew she'd need it, and I told her to take it.

grounded_facts: Han questions Rey about her ability to use a blaster, evaluating her skills and readiness.
memories.memory_text: I asked Rey if she knew how to use a blaster, and when she said all you do is pull the trigger, I told her there's a lot more to it and that she's got a lot to learn.

grounded_facts: Han suggests hiring Rey as a second mate, testing her interest in joining his crew.
memories.memory_text: I suggested to Rey that I was thinking about bringing on a second mate for the Falcon, someone who could keep up with Chewie and me and appreciate the ship, testing if she might be interested in joining my crew.

grounded_facts: Rey declines Han's implied job offer, choosing to return home instead of accepting a role aboard the Falcon.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey say she'd already been away too long, and I realized she was declining my offer because she felt duty-bound to return home instead of taking a role on the Falcon.

grounded_facts: A brief encounter between Han and Rey outside Maz's castle where Han assesses Rey and considers recruiting her.
memories.memory_text: I met Rey outside Maz's castle, gave her my blaster because I knew she'd need it, asked if she knew how to use it, and when she said all you do is pull the trigger, I told her there's a lot more to it. I learned her name was Rey, looked her over, questioned whether she could handle herself, and later thought it was too bad she wasn't joining us since Chewie kind of liked her.

grounded_facts: Han leads Rey and Finn to Maz Kanata's castle to secure a safe passage for BB-8 to the Resistance.
memories.memory_text: I led Rey and Finn to Maz Kanata's castle so we could get BB-8 to the Resistance safely.

grounded_facts: Han advises Rey and Finn not to stare at anything inside Maz's castle, indicating unusual or alien surroundings.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey and Finn to relax and let me do the talking when we got to Maz's castle, and I warned them not to stare at anything, since the place and Maz herself are a bit of an acquired taste.

grounded_facts: Han explains the necessity of visiting Maz Kanata to ensure BB-8 reaches the Resistance safely.
A planned stop at Maz Kanata's castle to seek her help in transporting BB-8 to the Resistance.
memories.memory_text: I explained to Rey and Finn that we needed to go to Maz because she's our best chance to get BB-8 to the Resistance, and I told them not to stare since she's an acquired taste.

grounded_facts: Maz Kanata suddenly becomes alert and turns to face Han Solo, recognizing him despite the crowded room.
Maz recognizes Han Solo in the crowd and calls out to him by name, breaking the ambient noise.
memories.memory_text: I saw Maz suddenly turn toward me in that crowded room, her eyes locking onto mine, and she shouted, 'Han Solo!'—just like that, breaking through all the noise.

grounded_facts: Han Solo, accompanied by Rey and Finn, arrives at Maz Kanata's castle, triggering recognition, silence, and renewed noise after greeting.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at Maz's castle with Rey and Finn, and I could feel the room go quiet when she spotted me and called out my name—then the noise kicked back up as I waved and said, 'Hey, Maz!'

grounded_facts: Maz asks Han about Chewbacca, expressing fondness for him.
memories.memory_text: Maz asked me where Chewbacca was and said she likes that Wookiee, calling him her boyfriend in that playful way she has.

grounded_facts: Maz assumes Han is in need of urgent help and urges him to state his business.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Maz that she assumes I need something desperately, and she urged me to state my business right away.

grounded_facts: Maz uses her enhanced vision to scrutinize Finn and declares he has the eyes of someone who wants to run, confronting his inner fear.
Maz uses her perceptual abilities and wisdom to expose Finn's fear of conflict, labeling him as someone who wants to run.
memories.memory_text: I saw Maz look at Finn with her sharp eyes and say he had the look of someone who wanted to run, and I realized she was calling out his fear in front of all of us.

grounded_facts: A meeting at Maz's castle where allies seek help, discuss the threat of the First Order, and experience internal conflict and separation.
memories.memory_text: I was at Maz's castle with Finn and the others, trying to get the droid to Leia, and I could feel the tension building as we talked about the First Order and what we should do.

grounded_facts: After losing faith in a fight against the First Order, Finn resolves to escape and arranges passage with alien smugglers to disappear.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn say there's no fight against the First Order we can win, that they'll slaughter us and we all need to run—he even told someone he needed passage to the Outer Rim to disappear.

grounded_facts: Finn confesses to Rey that he is not a Resistance hero but a former Stormtrooper who defected during his first battle, exposing his true identity and inner conflict.
Finn reveals his past as a Stormtrooper and his shame, attempting to justify his decision to leave.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn tell Rey that he wasn't a Resistance hero but a former Stormtrooper who was taken from his family and raised to fight, and that he ran during his first battle because he refused to kill for the First Order, admitting he was ashamed of what he was.

grounded_facts: Rey confronts Finn as he tries to leave and begs him not to go, expressing emotional dependence and disappointment.
Finn leaves Maz's castle with alien smugglers, rejecting the fight and abandoning the mission to deliver BB-8.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey confront Finn as he tried to leave, begging him not to go, but he walked away with the alien smugglers despite her plea, abandoning the mission.

grounded_facts: A crowd of aliens exits Maz's castle, reacting with fear and horror to a fire in the sky, creating a chaotic and tense atmosphere.
memories.memory_text: I saw a crowd of aliens rushing out of Maz's castle, terrified by the fire in the sky, and the whole place felt chaotic and tense as Chewie and I moved out to see what was happening.

grounded_facts: Finn arrives and informs Han and Chewbacca that the First Order has carried out an attack, identifying it as the source of the destruction in the sky.
Finn delivers urgent news to Han and Chewbacca, revealing that the First Order has caused the destruction seen in the sky.
memories.memory_text: Finn came to us and told me that the First Order was behind the attack, saying they were responsible for the destruction we saw in the sky.

grounded_facts: Han asks Maz where she obtained the lightsaber.
memories.memory_text: I asked Maz where she got that lightsaber, but she just told me it was a good question for another time.

grounded_facts: A moment organized around the transfer of a significant weapon from Maz to Finn.
Maz gives the lightsaber to Finn, urging him to use it to find his friend.
Maz commands Finn to take the lightsaber and go find his friend.
memories.memory_text: I saw Maz hand the lightsaber to Finn and tell him to take it and find his friend, right before the attack shook the room.

grounded_facts: The castle is shaken by an above-ground attack, indicating the arrival of enemy forces.
memories.memory_text: I was with Maz, Finn, and Chewie in the hall when the room suddenly shook from an above-ground attack, and I heard Maz shout that the enemy forces had arrived.

grounded_facts: Maz gives Finn the lightsaber, urging him to use it to help Rey and BB-8.
Maz tells Finn that Rey and BB-8 need him and gives him the lightsaber.
memories.memory_text: I saw Maz give Finn the lightsaber and tell him that Rey and BB-8 needed him, urging him to go help them.

grounded_facts: Han takes Chewbacca's bowcaster and uses it effectively against Stormtroopers.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Chewie's bowcaster and started firing at the Stormtroopers, sending them flying with the shots.

grounded_facts: Han tells Chewie he likes the bowcaster after using it.
memories.memory_text: I told Chewie, 'I like this thing,' after using his bowcaster because it really packed a punch.

grounded_facts: Finn uses the lightsaber in combat, showing bravery and athleticism despite lack of training.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn grab the lightsaber and take on those Stormtroopers—he was untrained but moved with real bravery and athleticism.

grounded_facts: A Stormtrooper calls Finn a traitor during combat.
memories.memory_text: I heard one of the Stormtroopers shout 'Traitor!' at Finn during the fight.

grounded_facts: Finn is knocked down by a mace-wielding Stormtrooper and nearly executed, but Han shoots the attacker and rescues him.
memories.memory_text: I watched Finn get knocked down by a Stormtrooper with a mace, and just as the guy was about to kill him, I shot him and ran over to help.

grounded_facts: Han shoots a Stormtrooper about to kill Finn and helps him up.
memories.memory_text: I shot the Stormtrooper who was about to execute Finn, then helped him up and asked if he was okay.

grounded_facts: Finn, Han, and Chewie are overwhelmed and forced to surrender, with the lightsaber confiscated.
memories.memory_text: I fought alongside Chewie and Finn, using his bowcaster to take down Stormtroopers until we were surrounded and had no choice but to drop our weapons—I saw the lightsaber get picked up by one of them before we were marched away.

grounded_facts: A combat engagement between Han, Chewie, Finn, Maz and First Order Stormtroopers at the ruins of a castle.
memories.memory_text: I fought alongside Chewie, Finn, and Maz against Stormtroopers in the castle ruins, using Chewie's bowcaster to take them down until we were overwhelmed and captured.

grounded_facts: X-Wings and Resistance spacecraft appear over the lake and begin attacking First Order ships.
memories.memory_text: I heard a familiar roar across the lake and turned to see X-Wings and Resistance spacecraft appear, opening fire on the First Order ships—I knew it was the Resistance coming to help.

grounded_facts: A specific black-marked X-Wing swoops down and destroys parked TIE Fighters and Troopers.
memories.memory_text: I saw one X-Wing in particular, marked in black, swoop down and take out the parked TIE Fighters and troopers.

grounded_facts: Finn picks up the lightsaber after it lands near him during the chaos of the battle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn pick up the lightsaber after it landed near him during the chaos of the battle.

grounded_facts: Han and Chewie retrieve weapons from the ground and begin fighting back against the stormtroopers.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed a blaster from the ground and started fighting back alongside Chewie.

grounded_facts: Han sees Kylo Ren entering the shuttle with Rey, causing him to stop in shock.
memories.memory_text: I stopped fighting when I saw Kylo Ren taking Rey onto his shuttle—I couldn't believe what I was seeing.

grounded_facts: Finn sees Kylo Ren carrying Rey into his shuttle, triggering emotional devastation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren carrying Rey into his shuttle, and it hit me hard — I just froze, realizing she was being taken.

grounded_facts: A firefight between Resistance allies (Han, Chewie, Finn) and First Order troops near the ruins of a castle, culminating in Kylo Ren's extraction with Rey.
Kylo Ren carries Rey into his shuttle, taking her captive as the First Order retreats.
memories.memory_text: I was fighting alongside Chewie and Finn near the castle ruins when I saw Kylo Ren carrying Rey into his shuttle, taking her captive as the First Order pulled back.

grounded_facts: Finn heroically runs toward the departing shuttle in a desperate attempt to save Rey.
memories.memory_text: I ran toward the shuttle, chasing it through the blasts and explosions, screaming for Rey as it took off.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren takes Rey away after the battle, resulting in her disappearance from the group.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn say Rey was gone and that Kylo Ren took her, so I figured she must have been captured and disappeared from the group.

grounded_facts: Finn urgently tells Han that Rey has been taken by Kylo Ren.
memories.memory_text: Finn came running up to me and told me that Kylo Ren took Rey.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath of a battle at Maz's castle ruins.
memories.memory_text: I was at the ruins of Maz's castle right after the battle, dealing with the aftermath.

grounded_facts: Leia arrives at Maz's castle ruins via Resistance transport, marking a key moment of character convergence.
memories.memory_text: I moved toward the Resistance transport landing in the debris, and when the door opened, I saw Leia standing there.

grounded_facts: Han and Leia see each other for the first time in years, sharing a silent, emotionally charged moment amid the ruins.
memories.memory_text: I saw Leia for the first time in years, and we shared a silent, emotional moment amid the smoke and embers—no words were needed.

grounded_facts: Han breaks the silence by noting Leia's changed hair, a small but intimate gesture.
memories.memory_text: I broke the silence by telling Leia she changed her hair—it felt like the easiest way to reach her after all this time.

grounded_facts: Leia responds to Han's comment with a reciprocal observation about his jacket.
memories.memory_text: Leia shot back that I was wearing the same jacket, and I could hear the old rhythm in her voice, like we never stopped.

grounded_facts: Chewbacca expresses joy at seeing Leia through a hug and vocalizations.
memories.memory_text: I saw Chewie greet Leia with a hug and a few warm moans—he was really glad to see her, and it reminded me how much they’ve been through together.

grounded_facts: Han tells Leia that he saw their son, Kylo Ren, at the ruins, marking a pivotal emotional disclosure.
memories.memory_text: I told Leia I saw our son at the ruins—he was there, and I had to let her know.

grounded_facts: The map retrieved from BB-8 is confirmed to be partially complete and unmatchable to any known system, making Luke's location still unknown.
memories.memory_text: I heard C-3PO tell Leia that the map from BB-8 was only partially complete and didn't match any known system, so we couldn't locate Luke, and I just stood there flummoxed, looking at the droid.

grounded_facts: A gathering at the Resistance base where the map from BB-8 is analyzed in an attempt to locate Luke Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I was at the Resistance base when C-3PO plugged BB-8's data into the computer and a hologram map appeared, with Leia studying it and then moving through the room while I followed her.

grounded_facts: Leia sarcastically questions the usefulness of Han's help, referencing past events with irony.
memories.memory_text: I tried to help Leia, but she shot me down with sarcasm, questioning when my help ever made a difference—and she even cut me off before I could mention the Death Star.

grounded_facts: Leia dismisses Han's attempt to comfort her, expressing frustration and emotional distance.
memories.memory_text: I tried to comfort Leia, but she shut me down immediately, telling me not to do anything, and shot down any attempt I had to remind her of past help—she even preemptively blocked me from mentioning the Death Star.

grounded_facts: Leia reveals that it was Snoke, not inherent darkness, that led Ben to the dark side, shifting the understanding of his fall and introducing hope for redemption.
Leia corrects the narrative of Ben's fall by identifying Snoke as the corrupting force, not internal darkness.
memories.memory_text: Leia told me that it wasn't some inherent darkness in Ben that turned him, but Snoke who seduced him to the dark side, and that we could still save him—me and her.

grounded_facts: Leia urges Han to recognize his unique importance as Ben's father, countering his sense of helplessness with hope and familial duty.
Leia argues that Han, as Ben's father, has a unique potential to reach him where Luke failed, redefining Han's perceived irrelevance in the conflict.
memories.memory_text: I remember Leia telling me that I have a chance to reach Ben because I'm his father, even though I doubted it—after all, if Luke couldn't do it, how could I?

grounded_facts: A private, emotionally intense conversation between Han and Leia where they confront shared grief over the loss of their son, Ben Solo.
memories.memory_text: I had a raw and painful conversation with Leia where we both confronted how much we’ve lost—our son, our marriage, everything—and I told her I went back to smuggling because it was the only thing I was ever good at, while she insisted we could still save Ben.

grounded_facts: Urgent meeting of Resistance leaders to assess Starkiller Base threat and formulate response.
memories.memory_text: I was in the room when the Resistance leaders gathered for an urgent meeting to assess the threat of Starkiller Base and figure out what to do next.

grounded_facts: Poe confirms that Snap's scan data supports Finn's earlier report about Starkiller Base.
memories.memory_text: I heard Poe confirm that Snap's scan data backed up Finn's earlier report about Starkiller Base, so I knew it wasn't just a story.

grounded_facts: Poe uses holographic comparison to reveal Starkiller Base's immense size relative to the Death Star, shocking the group.
memories.memory_text: I saw Poe use the hologram to compare Starkiller Base to the Death Star, and when he said 'This is Starkiller Base,' I realized how massive this thing really was.

grounded_facts: Finn explains that the weapon draws power from a star, draining it until it disappears.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn explain that the weapon uses the power of the sun, draining it until the star disappears as it charges.

grounded_facts: Leia receives data confirming the First Order is recharging Starkiller Base's weapon, with their system as the next target.
memories.memory_text: I was told the First Order is recharging the weapon and that our system is the next target.

grounded_facts: Admiral Statura hypothesizes a thermal oscillator is needed to contain the weapon's power, and Finn confirms its existence and location at Precinct 47.
memories.memory_text: I heard Admiral Statura say the base would need a thermal oscillator to contain the weapon's power, and then Finn confirmed it's real and located at Precinct 47.

grounded_facts: Han directly asks Finn for information about disabling the shields, leveraging his insider knowledge.
memories.memory_text: I asked the kid, Finn, what he knew about disabling the shields since he worked there.

grounded_facts: Finn declares he can disable the shields of Starkiller Base, but must be on the planet to do so.
memories.memory_text: Finn told me he could disable the shields, but he said he'd have to be on the planet to do it.

grounded_facts: Han promises to get Finn to the surface of Starkiller Base to disable the shields.
memories.memory_text: I promised Finn we'd get him down to the surface so he could disable the shields.

grounded_facts: Leia expresses concern about Han's unspecified method for getting Finn to the planet.
memories.memory_text: Leia saw me make that promise and asked me how I planned to pull it off, like she didn't trust my method.

grounded_facts: Group agrees on a plan: disable shields, destroy oscillator, and destroy the weapon.
memories.memory_text: I committed to the plan: we disable the shields, destroy the oscillator, and then blow up the weapon.

grounded_facts: Han jokes that he did things so Leia would miss him, lightening the emotional tension.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Han jokes that he did things so Leia would miss him, lightening the emotional tension.

grounded_facts: Leia confirms she missed Han, reciprocating his emotional openness.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Leia confirms she missed Han, reciprocating his emotional openness.

grounded_facts: Han shares a heartfelt moment with Leia before departure, reflecting on their past and expressing implied affection.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Han shares a heartfelt moment with Leia before departure, reflecting on their past and expressing implied affection.

grounded_facts: Leia asks Han to bring their son home if he sees him, revealing familial stakes and emotional vulnerability.
Leia makes an emotional appeal to Han regarding their son.
memories.memory_text: Leia looked at me and said, 'If you see our son again, bring him home,' and I could hear how much she meant it—she was trusting me with something deeper than a mission.

grounded_facts: Han, Chewie, and Finn prepare the Millennium Falcon for a final, dangerous mission.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Han, Chewie, and Finn prepare the Millennium Falcon for a final, dangerous mission.

grounded_facts: Han reveals the plan to approach the target at lightspeed by exploiting the enemy shields' fractional refresh rate.
Han explains to Finn that the enemy shields can be bypassed by approaching at lightspeed due to their fractional refresh rate.
memories.memory_text: I explained to Finn that the enemy shields have a fractional refresh rate, so I can bypass them by approaching at lightspeed.

grounded_facts: Finn reacts with sudden dread upon realizing the landing will be attempted at lightspeed.
Finn reacts with alarm upon realizing the landing will be attempted at lightspeed.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn react with alarm when he realized we'd be landing at lightspeed, and he asked me, 'We're gonna make our landing approach at lightspeed?!'

grounded_facts: Han gives the command and, with Chewie, activates switches to execute the lightspeed landing approach.
memories.memory_text: I gave the command and worked with Chewie to hit the switches for the lightspeed landing approach.

grounded_facts: Han assures Chewie that he is pulling up in response to Chewie's anxious groan.
memories.memory_text: I told Chewie I was pulling up when he groaned anxiously, so he'd know I had control.

grounded_facts: Han shouts a justification for not ascending further, indicating the risk of detection.
memories.memory_text: I shouted to my companion that if I went any higher, they'd see us, explaining why I couldn't keep ascending.

grounded_facts: The Millennium Falcon dives back into the trees to avoid being seen after ascending toward the sky.
memories.memory_text: I dove the Millennium Falcon back into the tree cover to avoid being seen after we started ascending toward the sky.

grounded_facts: Finn discloses that his former role at Starkiller Base was in sanitation, not in technical or security operations.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn say he used to work in sanitation at Starkiller Base, which made me question how much he really knows.

grounded_facts: Han challenges Finn's knowledge after learning his former job was in sanitation.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Finn, asking how he could know how to disable the shields if he was just in sanitation.

grounded_facts: Finn confesses he does not know how to disable the shields and states his sole purpose is rescuing Rey.
memories.memory_text: I learned from Finn that he doesn’t actually know how to disable the shields—he only came to rescue Rey.

grounded_facts: Finn tries to calm Han's frustration by suggesting they use the Force.
memories.memory_text: Finn told me we should use the Force to figure things out, trying to calm me down.

grounded_facts: Finn suggests using the Force to overcome their technical challenges, despite lacking understanding of it.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn suggest using the Force to overcome our technical problems, but he clearly doesn't understand it, so I told him that's not how it works.

grounded_facts: Chewie vocalizes discomfort due to the cold environment.
memories.memory_text: I heard Chewie moaning about the cold, so I shot back with a sarcastic 'Oh really, you're cold?'

grounded_facts: Han, Finn, and Chewie traverse the snowy exterior of Starkiller Base toward the flooding tunnels.
memories.memory_text: I remember trudging through the snow with Finn and Chewie, making our way across the icy terrain toward the base.

grounded_facts: Han expresses urgency and asks Finn for information about the status of the shields.
memories.memory_text: I felt the pressure building and asked Finn about the shields because we couldn't afford to wait much longer.

grounded_facts: Finn informs Han that he has an idea about the shields, offering a solution under pressure.
memories.memory_text: Finn told me he had an idea about the shields, and under the pressure, I trusted him and let him take the lead.

grounded_facts: Finn indicates he has an idea about disabling or dealing with the base's shields, prompting movement forward.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn step up and indicate he had a plan to deal with the shields, which shifted the momentum forward.

grounded_facts: Phasma identifies Finn by his former Stormtrooper designation, acknowledging their past chain of command.
memories.memory_text: I heard Phasma call Finn by his old designation, FN-2187, acknowledging him from her command days, like she recognized exactly who he used to be.

grounded_facts: Finn rejects his Stormtrooper designation and declares himself in charge, marking a personal turning point.
memories.memory_text: I watched Finn reject that old name and declare himself in charge—saying 'The name's Finn, and I'm in charge'—and I knew this was his moment of breaking free.

grounded_facts: Finn, with Han and Chewbacca's support, captures Captain Phasma and asserts authority over her.
memories.memory_text: I stood behind Finn as he confronted Captain Phasma, with Chewie holding her in place, and I saw him take charge right then—blaster in hand, making it clear he wasn't just some stormtrooper anymore.

grounded_facts: Captain Phasma is captured and forced to disable the shields, then considered for disposal by the team.
memories.memory_text: I saw Phasma sitting at the workstation with Finn, Chewie, and me aiming our blasters at her, and I watched her disable the shields after Chewie prodded her.

grounded_facts: Han suggests disposing of Captain Phasma by throwing her into a garbage chute or trash compactor.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we throw Phasma into a garbage chute or trash compactor to get rid of her.

grounded_facts: Finn outlines a plan to use explosives to blow the blast door and offers to draw fire, requesting cover.
memories.memory_text: Finn told me he planned to use explosives to blow the blast door and that he'd go in to draw fire, but he'd need me to provide cover.

grounded_facts: Rey climbs out from inside the wall and returns to the main level, surprising Finn, Han, and Chewie.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey climb out from inside the wall and return to the main level, which surprised Finn and Chewie — and honestly, me too, though I tried not to show it.

grounded_facts: Finn immediately asks if Rey was hurt, showing care and emotional investment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn immediately ask Rey if she was hurt, showing how much he cared.

grounded_facts: Finn, Han, and Chewbacca arrive at Starkiller Base to extract Rey, successfully reuniting with her.
memories.memory_text: I arrived with Finn and Chewie to extract Rey, and I saw her react when she spotted us.

grounded_facts: Chewie communicates that the rescue was Finn's idea, which Rey conveys with emotional weight.
memories.memory_text: I heard Chewie say something, and then Rey told Finn it was his idea to come rescue her, saying it with a lot of emotion.

grounded_facts: A brief emotional reunion between Rey, Finn, Han, and Chewie after Rey's escape and the team's arrival.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Rey and Finn embrace, and I saw Chewie greet her—there was a brief, emotional moment between them.

grounded_facts: Rey and Finn share an emotional hug after being reunited.
memories.memory_text: I watched Rey and Finn share an emotional hug when they reunited, just after they found each other.

grounded_facts: Rey manages to get away from being held, though she cannot explain how and believes others would not believe her.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey say she couldn't explain how she escaped and that we wouldn't believe her, so I know she went through something I don't fully understand.

grounded_facts: Han interrupts the emotional moment to refocus the group on immediate survival.
memories.memory_text: I interrupted the emotional moment because I knew we had to focus on escaping first.

grounded_facts: Han decides that they cannot leave and must help the Resistance forces who are in trouble, proposing to use explosives to intervene.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Resistance was in trouble and realized we couldn't just leave them to fend for themselves.

grounded_facts: Han tells Finn that Chewie has explosives and suggests using them to help in the battle.
memories.memory_text: I told Finn that my friend Chewie has explosives and suggested we use them to help turn the tide of the battle.

grounded_facts: Chewbacca eliminates one of the three stormtroopers guarding the maintenance hatch with his bowcaster.
memories.memory_text: I saw Chewie take out the middle stormtrooper with his bowcaster right away.

grounded_facts: Han Solo and the remaining two stormtroopers exchange blaster fire, with Han successfully hitting his targets.
memories.memory_text: I exchanged blaster fire with the other two stormtroopers and managed to hit them both.

grounded_facts: The security alarms begin blaring following the firefight, indicating detection of unauthorized activity.
memories.memory_text: I heard the alarms start blaring right after the firefight, so I knew we'd been detected.

grounded_facts: Han and Chewie enter the Oscillator Structure through an opening hatch, with weapons ready.
memories.memory_text: I entered the Oscillator Structure with Chewie through an opening hatch, keeping my weapon ready as we stepped inside.

grounded_facts: Han expresses approval of the girl's competence.
memories.memory_text: I said to myself that the girl knows her stuff, impressed by how competent she seemed in the moment.

grounded_facts: Han finishes placing an explosive device in the oscillator structure.
Han checks he's all-clear and hurries down to the next level of the structure.
memories.memory_text: I finished placing the explosive and checked that I was all-clear before hurrying down to the next level.

grounded_facts: Han chooses to reveal himself to Kylo Ren instead of escaping, driven by emotional conflict and Leia's words.
memories.memory_text: I heard something and stayed hidden, watching my son move across the catwalk — I could have escaped then, but Leia's words kept echoing in my mind, and I knew I had to face him instead.

grounded_facts: Han uses the name 'Ben' to appeal to Kylo Ren's former identity.
memories.memory_text: I called out to him, using the name 'Ben' — the name he had before all this darkness — hoping it might reach the son I still believe is alive inside that mask.

grounded_facts: In response to Han's plea, Kylo Ren takes off his mask, revealing his face.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren take off his mask, and I was jolted when I saw my son's face for the first time as a man.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren claims that Han's son is gone and that he destroyed him.
memories.memory_text: Kylo Ren told me that my son is gone and that he destroyed him, calling him weak and foolish like me.

grounded_facts: Han emotionally acknowledges Kylo Ren as his son despite the latter's denial.
memories.memory_text: I looked at him and said those words—'the face of my son'—and I told him that my son is still alive, no matter what Snoke made him believe.

grounded_facts: A pivotal emotional encounter between Han Solo and Kylo Ren on a catwalk in the Oscillator Structure, witnessed by Finn, Rey, and Chewbacca.
memories.memory_text: I saw the pain in my son's face when he took off his mask, and I told him I still believe my son is alive — not knowing if Finn, Rey, or even Chewie were watching, but meaning every word.

grounded_facts: A pivotal encounter between Han Solo and Kylo Ren on the lower level of the Oscillator Structure, where Han attempts to reclaim his son from the dark side.
Han confronts Kylo Ren with truth and love, urging him to leave the First Order and return home, appealing to familial bonds.
memories.memory_text: I moved closer to Kylo on the bridge and told him that Snoke is using him for his power and will crush him when he's no longer useful, then urged him to leave with me and come home because we miss him.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren expresses emotional turmoil and a desire to be free from pain, showing genuine hesitation and vulnerability in the face of Han's appeal.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo hesitate and realized he knew the truth, and for the first time, I saw real conflict in him—tears in his eyes—and I heard him say he's being torn apart and wants to be free of the pain.

grounded_facts: In response to Kylo Ren's plea for help, Han affirms his unconditional support.
memories.memory_text: I heard my son ask me for help, trembling with doubt, and I told him yes—anything—he could count on me.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren slowly extends his unlit lightsaber toward Han, seemingly asking for help or validation, creating a moment of vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren slowly extend his unlit lightsaber toward me, close enough that I could feel its weight in the air, and in that moment, I believed he was asking for my help, that he still had a chance to come back.

grounded_facts: After Han reaches for the lightsaber, Kylo Ren ignites it, impaling Han through the chest, resulting in his death.
Kylo Ren ignites his lightsaber through Han's chest, killing him, after Han reaches toward the offered weapon; Han falls from the catwalk into the depths.
memories.memory_text: I reached for the lightsaber, hoping it meant he was coming back to me, but then I saw the darkness in his eyes — he ignited it through my chest, and I felt myself falling, slipping away as I looked into my son's face one last time.

grounded_facts: A private, emotionally charged encounter between Han and his son Kylo Ren atop the catwalk of the oscillator structure, culminating in Han's death.
memories.memory_text: I stepped toward my son, saw him extend his lightsaber toward me, and in my last moment, I looked into his face before falling from the catwalk.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren lands in a shuttle and exits to confront Lor San Tekka, asserting authority over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren land in a massive shuttle and stride out toward Lor San Tekka, taking control of everything.

grounded_facts: A dying trooper marks the protagonist stormtrooper's helmet with blood, creating a symbolic and personal moment before death.
memories.memory_text: I felt a dying trooper mark my helmet with blood, a moment that struck me deeply before he passed.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between First Order troops and villagers, resulting in executions and captures.
memories.memory_text: I stood there, overwhelmed by the battle after seeing the executions and captures of the villagers.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren kills Lor San Tekka after a tense exchange, eliminating a key figure who holds knowledge of Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren kill Lor San Tekka after a tense exchange—he ignited his lightsaber and cut him down right in front of me.

grounded_facts: Poe attempts to attack Kylo Ren and mocks his mask, showing resistance.
memories.memory_text: I watched Poe try to attack Kylo Ren and mock his mask, firing his blaster even though he had to know the odds.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren questions Poe about the map to Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren kneel down and question Poe about the map to Skywalker, demanding to know if the old man had given it to him before ordering the troopers to search him.

grounded_facts: On Kylo Ren's order, Captain Phasma commands stormtroopers to kill all villagers.
memories.memory_text: I heard Kylo Ren order the villagers killed, and Captain Phasma gave the command to fire—I remember her voice shouting 'Fire!' over the comms.

grounded_facts: Poe is immobilized by Kylo Ren's Force power, seized by stormtroopers, and taken aboard a transport ship.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren stop Poe’s blaster bolt in midair with the Force, then freeze him in place before the stormtroopers dragged him away and loaded him onto a transport.

grounded_facts: The blood-marked stormtrooper does not participate in the execution of the villagers, showing internal conflict.
memories.memory_text: I didn't raise my blaster when the others opened fire—I just stood there, frozen, unable to follow the order.

grounded_facts: Kylo Ren pauses and stares at the blood-marked stormtrooper, seemingly detecting something unusual.
memories.memory_text: I saw Kylo Ren stop and turn back, staring right at me, and I could barely meet his gaze—I felt exposed, like he'd sensed something was wrong, and I was sure I was doomed.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 removes his helmet upon entering the transport vehicle, exposing his face for the first time.
memories.memory_text: I removed my helmet as I entered the transport, exposing my face for the first time.

grounded_facts: Captain Phasma commands FN-2187 to submit his blaster for inspection, asserting authority.
memories.memory_text: I was ordered by Captain Phasma to submit my blaster for inspection.

grounded_facts: Captain Phasma questions FN-2187's unauthorized removal of his helmet, reinforcing disciplinary control.
memories.memory_text: I remember Captain Phasma demanding to know who gave me permission to remove my helmet.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 apologizes and obeys Captain Phasma's orders without resistance.
memories.memory_text: I apologized to Captain Phasma and obeyed her orders without resisting.

grounded_facts: Captain Phasma commands FN-2187 to report to her division immediately, escalating disciplinary action.
Captain Phasma scolds FN-2187 for removing his helmet without permission and orders him to submit his blaster and report to her division.
memories.memory_text: After scolding me for removing my helmet and taking my blaster, Captain Phasma commanded me to report to her division immediately.

grounded_facts: After being reprimanded, FN-2187 puts his helmet back on, retreating into concealment and compliance.
memories.memory_text: After being reprimanded, I put my helmet back on, retreating into silence and compliance.

grounded_facts: A brief, tense interaction between Captain Phasma and FN-2187 inside a dark transport vehicle at night.
memories.memory_text: I felt tense when Captain Phasma entered behind me and ordered me to report to her division immediately, and I quickly put my helmet back on after she left.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 removes his helmet and directly informs Poe that he is there to rescue him and asks if he can fly a TIE fighter.
A clandestine meeting between FN-2187 and Poe in a narrow hallway aboard a Star Destroyer, where FN-2187 initiates a rescue mission.
FN-2187, a Stormtrooper, reveals his identity and initiates a rescue operation to help Poe escape from the Star Destroyer by offering him a chance to flee using a TIE fighter.
memories.memory_text: I stopped Poe in the hallway, pulled off my helmet so he’d see it was me, and told him I was getting him out—this was a rescue, and I needed to know if he could fly a TIE fighter.

grounded_facts: Poe asserts that he can fly any spacecraft and questions why FN-2187 is helping him, seeking clarification on motives.
memories.memory_text: I remember Poe saying he could fly anything, and then he asked me why I was helping him.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 states that he is helping Poe because it is the right thing to do, establishing ethical justification for his actions.
memories.memory_text: I told Poe I was helping him because it's the right thing to do, and I meant it.

grounded_facts: After realizing FN-2187's intentions are genuine, Poe agrees to participate in the escape plan and expresses confidence in their success.
memories.memory_text: I saw Poe realize I was serious about the escape, and he smiled at me before saying, 'We're gonna do this,' which made me believe he truly trusted the plan and was ready to fight with me.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 speaks to himself to maintain composure during the escape attempt.
memories.memory_text: I remember that FN-2187 speaks to himself to maintain composure during the escape attempt.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 begins executing an escape plan by guiding Poe toward a TIE fighter, pretending to escort a prisoner.
memories.memory_text: I remember that FN-2187 begins executing an escape plan by guiding Poe toward a TIE fighter, pretending to escort a prisoner.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 directs Poe to follow him toward the TIE fighter.
memories.memory_text: I remember that FN-2187 directs Poe to follow him toward the TIE fighter.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 and Poe enter the back-to-back cockpit of a TIE Fighter and prepare for flight.
memories.memory_text: I entered the back-to-back cockpit of a TIE Fighter with Poe and started preparing for flight, pulling off my helmet as he removed his cuffs and jacket to power up the ship.

grounded_facts: Poe powers up the TIE Fighter, which lurches forward abruptly.
memories.memory_text: I saw Poe power up the TIE Fighter and it lurched forward suddenly, catching me off guard as we got into the cockpit.

grounded_facts: Poe explains how to operate the TIE Fighter's weapons to FN-2187.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Poe how to use the weapons, explaining that I should use the toggle on the left to switch between missiles, cannons, and mag pulse.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 finds the TIE Fighter controls complex and difficult to use.
memories.memory_text: I found the controls of the TIE Fighter really complicated and told Poe, 'This is very complicated,' struggling to make sense of them.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 initiates weapon fire in the TIE Fighter.
memories.memory_text: I opened fire in the TIE Fighter.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 uses precise laser blasts to destroy parked TIE fighters, gun emplacements, and the control room in the hangar.
memories.memory_text: I used precise laser blasts to destroy the parked TIE fighters, gun emplacements, and the control room in the hangar.

grounded_facts: Poe begins piloting the Tie Fighter with enthusiasm, indicating a shift in responsibility and control of the vehicle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Poe take control of the Tie Fighter and he seemed really excited, almost like he was enjoying flying it, saying 'Woooahhh! This thing really moves.'

grounded_facts: Poe declares the necessity of destroying enemy cannons to progress, establishing a tactical objective.
memories.memory_text: I remember Poe telling me we had to destroy as many cannons as possible, or we wouldn't get very far.

grounded_facts: Poe tells FN to stay alert while he maneuvers the Tie Fighter.
memories.memory_text: Poe told me to stay sharp while he got us into position, so I knew I had to stay alert.

grounded_facts: Poe communicates the target's position and alignment to the crew to enable firing.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Poe to watch ahead and that he had us dead centered on the target for a clean shot.

grounded_facts: Poe alerts the team to the target ahead and confirms their position for a clean shot.
memories.memory_text: I heard Poe shout 'Up ahead! You see it?' and then confirm we were dead centered with a clean shot, so I knew the target was lined up.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 acquires a target and fires the weapon system of the TIE Fighter.
memories.memory_text: I acquired the target and fired the weapon system of the TIE Fighter.

grounded_facts: Poe renames FN-2187 as 'Finn', marking a break from his past identity as a stormtrooper and symbolizing his emergence as an individual.
Poe rejects FN-2187's serial designation and gives him the name 'Finn', establishing personal recognition and respect.
memories.memory_text: Poe told me he wasn't going to use my old designation and said he'd call me Finn instead, asking if that was all right, which made me feel seen as a person.

grounded_facts: Finn expresses enthusiastic approval of his new name, signaling emotional connection and willingness to embrace a new identity.
memories.memory_text: I said 'Finn' out loud and told Poe I liked that name, because I really did—I felt happy claiming it as my own.

grounded_facts: Poe makes the decision to go back to Jakku to retrieve his droid before the First Order does.
memories.memory_text: I was told we're going back to Jakku to retrieve Poe's droid before the First Order does.

grounded_facts: Finn strongly opposes Poe's decision to return to Jakku, arguing it would lead to their deaths.
memories.memory_text: I argued that going back to Jakku would get us killed—we need to get as far away from the First Order as we can.

grounded_facts: Poe reveals to Finn that the BB unit droid carries a map to Luke Skywalker, justifying his decision to return to Jakku.
memories.memory_text: Poe told me that the droid carries a map that leads straight to Luke Skywalker, which is why he wants to go back to Jakku.

grounded_facts: Finn discovers that the BB unit droid possesses a map leading directly to Luke Skywalker.
memories.memory_text: I started to piece together that the orange and white BB unit droid must have a map leading directly to Luke Skywalker, since Poe was so desperate to get back to Jakku to find it.

grounded_facts: FN-2187 was evaluated and assigned to Reconditioning after his first offense.
memories.memory_text: I was evaluated and sent to Reconditioning after my first offense.

grounded_facts: Finn finds what he believes to be Poe's arm in the wreckage of the TIE Fighter, but it turns out to be only his jacket.
memories.memory_text: I thought I saw Poe's arm in the wreckage, so I pulled on it, but it was just his jacket.

grounded_facts: The crashed TIE Fighter begins sinking into the sand like quicksand, forcing Finn to retreat to avoid being pulled in.
memories.memory_text: I tried to get closer to the TIE Fighter, but it started sinking into the sand like quicksand, and I had to scramble away to keep from being pulled in.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath of the TIE Fighter crash in the Jakku desert, where Finn searches for Poe and confronts the loss.
memories.memory_text: I saw the TIE fighter smoking and sinking into the sand, and I knew I couldn't save Poe from the wreckage, confronting the loss as I struggled to stay safe.

grounded_facts: Finn repeatedly shouts for Poe, expressing desperation and fear after waking up in the desert.
memories.memory_text: I shouted for Poe again and again, desperate and afraid, pulling at what I thought was his arm only to find it was just his jacket.

grounded_facts: Finn regains consciousness in the Jakku desert and immediately becomes terrified upon realizing his surroundings.
memories.memory_text: I woke up in the Jakku desert and immediately felt terrified, scrambling over a massive dune as I realized where I was.

grounded_facts: Finn repurposes Poe's flight jacket as a means of protection from the sun in the desert.
Finn removes pieces of his Stormtrooper armor while walking through the desert, symbolizing a break from his past identity.
memories.memory_text: I removed my Stormtrooper armor piece by piece as I walked, leaving parts behind in the sand, and I used Poe's flight jacket to shield myself from the sun—it was no longer just a pilot’s gear, but mine, a way to survive and to stop being FN-2187.

grounded_facts: Finn persists in moving through the vast desert despite exhaustion.
memories.memory_text: I keep moving across the endless desert, even though I'm completely exhausted.

grounded_facts: Finn arrives at the edge of a massive dune, where he sees Niima Outpost in the distance.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at the edge of a massive dune and saw Niima Outpost in the distance, giving me hope that I had a direction again.

grounded_facts: Finn, dehydrated and disoriented, drinks from a trough used by a happabore, spits it out in disgust, but returns due to thirst.
memories.memory_text: I was so dehydrated and disoriented that I drank from a trough the happabore was using, spat it out in disgust, but ended up going back because I was too thirsty to resist.

grounded_facts: Rey confronts Finn, believing he stole Poe's jacket and droid, and attacks him with her staff.
memories.memory_text: I was running from Rey when she caught up and slammed me to the ground with her staff, accusing me of being a thief.

grounded_facts: BB-8 uses his welding arm to shock Finn in response to Finn wearing Poe's jacket.
memories.memory_text: I was wearing Poe's jacket when BB-8 suddenly rolled up and shocked me with his welding arm, and I yelled out in pain.

grounded_facts: Finn sees BB-8 and realizes the droid belongs to Poe Dameron, triggering emotional and narrative consequences.
memories.memory_text: I saw BB-8 and realized it was Poe Dameron's droid—I remembered his name and knew this droid had to be important.

grounded_facts: Under accusation, Finn chooses to reveal that he knew Poe Dameron and that Poe died during their escape.
memories.memory_text: I told them I helped Poe escape, but our ship crashed and I didn't make it out with him — Poe didn't survive.

grounded_facts: Finn falsely claims to be a member of the Resistance to align himself with Poe and gain Rey's trust.
After revealing the truth about Poe, Finn lies and claims he is a member of the Resistance to maintain credibility.
memories.memory_text: I told Rey I was with the Resistance, even though it wasn't true—I said it to make her trust me after I admitted I tried to help Poe and failed.

grounded_facts: Stormtroopers arrive at the outpost and are directed by Unkar's thugs toward Finn and Rey, initiating pursuit.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed stormtroopers arrive at the outpost and get directed by Unkar's thugs toward Rey and me, which triggered our escape.

grounded_facts: Finn grabs Rey's hand to pull her to safety upon seeing stormtroopers approaching.
memories.memory_text: I saw the stormtroopers approaching and immediately grabbed Rey's hand to pull her to safety.

grounded_facts: Upon spotting stormtroopers, Finn grabs Rey's hand and leads her into hiding as blaster fire begins.
memories.memory_text: When I spotted the stormtroopers, I grabbed Rey's hand and led her into hiding just as blaster fire began ripping past us.

grounded_facts: Unkar's thugs attempt to seize BB-8; Rey resists, fights them off using physical force, and protects the droid.
memories.memory_text: I saw Unkar's thugs trying to grab BB-8, and I watched Rey fight them off when the laser blasts started flying around us.

grounded_facts: A confrontation and series of revelations unfold in the Niima Outpost marketplace involving Rey, BB-8, Finn, thugs, and stormtroopers.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey fighting in the marketplace, recognized BB-8 as Poe's droid, and when he shocked me, I knew things were about to get complicated; I told her BB-8 carried a map to Luke Skywalker and that everyone was after it, then grabbed her hand and ran when the stormtroopers opened fire.

grounded_facts: Finn calls out to BB-8 to stay with them during the escape.
memories.memory_text: I called out to BB-8 to keep up with us, telling him to come on so we wouldn't lose him during the escape.

grounded_facts: Rey tells Finn she doesn’t need his handholding to run, pulling away.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey tell me she didn’t need me holding her hand to run, and in that moment I knew she wanted to do this on her own.

grounded_facts: Rey pulls her hand back from Finn, expressing discomfort with physical contact during escape.
memories.memory_text: I felt Rey pull her hand away from mine while we were running, and I realized she didn't want me holding her hand anymore.

grounded_facts: After breaking contact, Rey directs the group's movement, signaling a shift in initiative.
memories.memory_text: After she broke contact, I saw Rey take charge and lead us through the tents, directing BB-8 and me where to go next.

grounded_facts: Rey, Finn, and BB-8 flee through a tent maze at Niima Outpost while being pursued by stormtroopers.
memories.memory_text: I was running with Rey and BB-8 through the maze of tents at Niima Outpost, trying to stay ahead of the stormtroopers chasing us.

grounded_facts: Reacting to what he hears, Finn physically takes Rey's hand and pulls her away for safety.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Rey's hand and pulled her away because I sensed danger and needed to protect her.

grounded_facts: Finn detects a sound that causes him alarm, prompting immediate action.
memories.memory_text: I heard a sound that alarmed me, and I knew I had to act fast to keep Rey safe.

grounded_facts: Rey expresses irritation at Finn's repeated physical contact, specifically grabbing her hand.
memories.memory_text: I remember Rey saying, 'Stop taking my hand!'—she was clearly annoyed by me grabbing her hand again.

grounded_facts: After being knocked unconscious, Finn comes to and immediately asks Rey if she is okay, marking a moment of emotional significance for her.
Finn, just regaining consciousness, asks Rey if she is okay, a simple question that deeply affects her due to its novelty in her life.
memories.memory_text: I came to after being knocked out and the first thing I did was ask Rey if she was okay—I could tell it meant something to her.

grounded_facts: Rey extends her hand to Finn, who takes it gratefully, and she leads him as they begin fleeing the attack together.
Rey extends her hand to Finn and leads him in escaping the attack, establishing a moment of trust and cooperation.
memories.memory_text: I was still regaining myself when Rey extended her hand and told me to follow her; I took it gratefully and ran with her, trusting her to lead us to safety as the TIE fighters kept bombing the area.

grounded_facts: Two TIE fighters attack the tent where Rey and Finn are, causing a massive explosion that throws both of them to the ground, with Finn becoming unconscious.
A sudden aerial assault by two TIE fighters on the Niima Outpost, targeting the tent area where Rey and Finn are located.
memories.memory_text: I remember pulling Rey out of the tent when the TIE fighters dove down and opened fire — the blast threw us both to the ground, and then everything went black.

grounded_facts: Rey confidently declares herself as a pilot when Finn expresses the need for one.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey say we had a ship, and when I asked if she could fly, she told me she was a pilot.

grounded_facts: Rey rejects Finn's suggestion of using another ship, calling it garbage.
memories.memory_text: I suggested another ship, but Rey rejected it, telling me it was garbage.

grounded_facts: The quad-jumper, intended for escape, is destroyed by TIE fighters' fire.
memories.memory_text: I saw the TIE fighters fire at the quad-jumper and blow it apart right in front of us.

grounded_facts: Rey initially dismisses the Millennium Falcon as garbage but quickly decides to use it when their original escape ship is destroyed.
memories.memory_text: I saw Rey stop and shout that the garbage'll do, then she ran toward the Millennium Falcon and I followed with BB-8.

grounded_facts: Rey, Finn, and BB-8 attempt to flee from pursuing TIE fighters by reaching a functional spacecraft at the spaceport.
memories.memory_text: I was running with Rey and BB-8 through the spaceport, trying to reach a working ship while TIE fighters were coming back to attack us.

grounded_facts: Rey, Finn, and BB-8 enter the Millennium Falcon and close the door behind them as they prepare for immediate departure.
memories.memory_text: I entered the Millennium Falcon with Rey and BB-8, and I saw her close the door right after we got in as we rushed to get the ship ready to go.

grounded_facts: Rey informs Finn of the location of the gunner position on the Millennium Falcon, directing him to take it.
Rey tells Finn where the gunner position is located, directing him to take it.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Rey where the gunner position is on the Millennium Falcon, and she directed me to take it.

grounded_facts: Finn asks Rey if she has ever flown the Millennium Falcon before.
memories.memory_text: I asked Rey if she'd ever flown the Millennium Falcon before, wondering if she could handle it under pressure.

grounded_facts: Finn secures himself in the gunner seat aboard the Millennium Falcon, experiencing an unexpected mechanical movement that startles him.
memories.memory_text: I buckled into the gunner seat and was about to prepare for combat, but then the seat suddenly whipped to the left—I grabbed the controls to steady myself.

grounded_facts: Finn urgently tells Rey to fly low to disrupt enemy tracking systems.
memories.memory_text: I urgently told Rey to stay low while flying because I knew it would confuse their tracking systems.

grounded_facts: Rey expresses frustration with Finn for not firing back quickly enough during the attack.
memories.memory_text: I heard Rey yelling at me, asking what I was doing and if I was ever going to fire back.

grounded_facts: The shields of the Millennium Falcon are not active, complicating defense efforts.
